lessons_used: Interactive flow additions produced the largest wins (up to +14.8%), though predictions were sometimes too optimistic as recent flow tests caused severe drops (down to -10.2%).
Step reordering generated strong wins (up to +12.0%), but carries high risk, frequently failing, showing no clear effect, or causing significant negative impacts (down to -8.9%).
Wait-state indicators produced solid wins (up to +6.1%), sometimes exceeding predictions (+6.1% vs +3.2% predicted), though others showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates achieved selective wins (+3.5% and +6.7%), but follow-up copy tweaks showed no clear effect.

UI redesigns, layout changes, standalone preview screens, hints, and notifications failed to produce any wins, with redesigns (down to -19.3%) and hints (down to -3.1%) often causing significant performance declines.

lessons_next: New interactive flows (new_flow) generated the largest wins (up to +14.8%), but predictions were often overly optimistic as several recent flow additions caused severe drops (down to -11.8%).
Step reordering (reorder) achieved high-impact wins (up to +12.0%), but carried significant risk, frequently showing no clear effect or causing severe drops (down to -8.9%).
Wait-state indicators (wait_info) produced solid wins (up to +6.1%), at times exceeding optimistic predictions (+6.1% vs +3.2% predicted), though several variants showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates (copy) yielded selective wins (up to +6.7%), though the majority of copy tests produced no clear effect.

UI redesigns, layout changes, hints, notifications, and standalone preview screens failed to produce any wins, with redesigns (down to -19.3%) and hints (down to -3.1%) often causing significant declines.
